hook.description: Gerald steps out of the carriage into the mud in an opulent coat.
hook.evidence: The visual contrast between the wealthy antagonist and the rustic setting immediately establishes a power imbalance.

candidates.reason: The confrontation escalates quickly from a surprise visit to a false accusation of theft.

hook.description: The constable barges into the cottage and begins violently overturning furniture.
hook.evidence: The sudden, aggressive invasion of a private home creates immediate tension and high stakes.

candidates.reason: The scene builds to the devastating discovery of the planted evidence, framing the hero for a crime he didn't commit.
